summary.headline: 1000000142: too few returned records to judge
summary.rationale: 1000000142 billed 99215 on 6.6% of 1,326 claims against an expected 4.8% given patient complexity (risk-adjusted score 0.68; plain z-score vs peers -0.16). 36% of this provider's 99215 claims were on patients with 0 or 1 chronic conditions. Records came back for 49 claims. Of 5 documented 99215 claims, 2 (40%) were documented below the billed level, against 44% for the comparison providers. Note checks on 30 returned notes (share showing each sign): problems 40%, late 7%, unsigned 0%, data 3%. No audit trail was received. 2 of 42 notes claiming moderate-or-higher data reviewed had no lab or test line on the claim. The 99215 share is 1.36 times expected. The pooled chart test was not triggered, and there were only 4 documented 99215 visits. Note signals are unremarkable: 6.7% signed late, 0% unsigned, no inflation signs. One minor deficiency (missing results). Data quality is clean. There is no basis for a demand. Examples: C0070601: billed 99215; documented MDM level moderate, 31 minutes. C0070709: billed 99215; documented MDM level moderate, 38 minutes. C0070467: billed 99215, patient aged 55 with 1 chronic condition(s) (chronic kidney disease). C0070490: billed 99215, patient aged 52 with 0 chronic condition(s).
next_steps: 49 charts came back but do not settle it: request a targeted sample of 99215 charts, starting with C0070601, C0070709, C0070467.
Re-check after the targeted charts arrive; do not call upcoding or a sicker panel on this evidence alone.
